verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent, so its own documented features yield AI insights and suggestions from the user's code and runtime data: explaining a repo or file, drafting plans before edits, and background monitors that report errors from logs or test runs. The evidence covers codebase and log analysis rather than general data analysis. missing for 10: insights over non-code user data, documented analytics or proactive suggestion features, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Useful first prompts: Explain this repo. @src/main.rs Walk me through this file.
In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.
Ask for one when you want to watch a log, a CI run, or a port ("watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors").
